page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries with Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Greek; running head at top with page number at top right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: ספן Chal. Honorare, In honore habere, Esth.1.12.& cap. 7.10. in Targ. sec. Ex Ithpehal יִסְתַּפַּן, vide suprà in ספג.
ספינתא, ספינא Ch. & Syr. Navis, proprie Tecta; (nam ספן Hebr. est Texit, obtexit) ut magnæ esse solent. Plur. fœm. ספינן, ספינתא, & masc. ספיני, ספינין. Et sic quoque Syr. ܣܦܝܢܐ Mar. 4.36.
ספינא Chald. & Syr. Nauta. Plur. ספנין, ספניא: Syriac. ܣܦܝܢܐ Act. 27.38.
סופינא Chald. Lancea, 2. Sam. 21.16. Affine est Græc. σαῦνη.
ספם ספסל Ch. Sedes, sedile, sella, scabellum. Plural. ספסלין, Genes.15.13. in Targ. Hierosol. Convenit aliquo modo Græc. σφέλας.

ספסרא Chald. ܣܦܣܪܐ Syriac. Gladius, Ensis, oblongus proprie, minusque latus ut censet Nic. Full. in Miscel. l.1.c.17. Affine est Græc. σαμψήρας, σαραϐ Καρβαζηνῶ, ut Suidas explicat. Item Persarum ܫܡܫܪ quod idem. Quo vocabulo etiam Tavasius usus est pro Hebr. תלי, (quod diversimodè explicatur.) ut Onkelos ספא, quod addi potest iis quæ Nicol. Full. de hac voce תלי dicto loco observavit. Plur. ספסרין, ספסרי, Syr. ܣܦܣܪܝ.
ספא ספא Ch. ܣܦܐ Syr. Postis, Limen, Vestibulum. Plur. ספין, ספיא.
ספק Chald. Plaudere, Percutere, Complodere, Scribitur nonnunquam cum ש: Item Chal. & Syriac.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee, Syriac and Greek words are rendered as far as legible; several vowel-pointed forms and the Syriac and Greek letters are approximate and should be checked against the scan. Page is otherwise clear.
